name: invUSD
oneLiner: invUSD is Inverse Finance's sINV-backed dollar, minted in a Monolith V1 CDP with 1:1 USDS swaps and borrower-specific collateral redemptions.
collateral: Single-collateral Monolith V1 Lender on Ethereum (0xf8b349da9244253288f6853835e6582955fd49c9) holding staked INV (sINV, 0x08d23468a467d2bb86fae0e32f247a26c7e2e994) at a 65% collateral factor; the same contract holds a USDS peg-stability reserve through sUSDS, which funds 1:1 PSM sells and is not borrower collateral.
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint invUSD against sINV up to 65% of collateral value, priced by ERC4626Feed multiplying the sINV vault exchange rate by a Timelock-switchable DynamicFeeCurveFeed (Curve INV/WETH EMA multiplied by Chainlink ETH/USD with a RedStone fallback, less the dynamic Curve fee capped at 2%). Paid debt accrues interest steered by the Monolith V1 InterestModel around a 15% to 35% target free-debt band; free debt pays no interest and is the only debt redeemable, with holders burning invUSD against an opted-in borrower at the oracle price less a 2.5% fee that the manager Safe or Timelock operator can raise to 5% before the 2030-04-23 immutability deadline. Liquidations are permissionless above 65% LTV with a 0 to 10% incentive, and a write-off rail socialises debt above 100 times collateral value. The in-Lender PSM mints and burns 1:1 against USDS held as sUSDS at 0 bps sell fee, capped on the sell side by freePsmAssets, with buys disabled at the immutability deadline. sInvUSD stakers receive borrower interest net of local and global reserve fees.
